key.name: api-key
key.description: Main or read-only API key used as bearer token against the UptimeRobot v3 API.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between two status checks against the UptimeRobot API.

key.name: notify-status-changes
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a shown monitor goes down or comes back up.

key.name: hidden-monitors
key.description: IDs (as strings) of the monitors that are hidden. Hidden monitors are not listed in the menu and do not influence the colour of the status dot. Monitors not in this list are shown, so newly created monitors appear automatically.
